# SellableCRM

> SellableCRM is a white-label lead-to-close service for US marketing agencies. Every lead an agency's clients receive is answered within a minute and followed up until it closes, all under the agency's brand. Our team builds and maintains the system inside each client's account.

## About
- Name: SellableCRM (sometimes written "Sellable CRM"). Website: sellablecrm.com.
- SellableCRM is a white-label lead-to-close service built on HighLevel and run by its own team of specialists. It is not a standalone CRM software product.
- Founded in September 2026 by Sabour Adeel (Founder), after three years working inside marketing agencies.
- Why it exists: agencies bring their clients leads, but when nobody replies fast, follows up or books the appointment, the leads go cold, the agency gets the blame and loses the retainer. Fixing it used to mean an expensive hire plus software to learn and pay for. SellableCRM sets up and runs the whole lead-to-close system for each client instead, under the agency's brand.
- About page: https://sellablecrm.com/about/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sellablecrm/ (company), https://www.linkedin.com/in/sabour-adeel/ (founder)

## What it does
- Who it's for: marketing agencies that want to offer a complete lead-to-close system to their clients without new hires. The agency's clients see only the agency's brand.
- Six core features, always on, in every client account: instant reply (a text and an email to every new lead), missed-call text-back, lead nurture (follow-up until they reply or book), team alerts, booking and reminders, and no-show recovery.
- Ready on day one: lead form, booking page, landing page and website chat.
- Seven add-ons, free to switch on: review requests, quote follow-up, service reminders, referral ask, keyword replies, old-lead reactivation, and an AI chat and voice agent (pay per use).
- Seven tools in every login: CRM and pipeline, inbox, calendar, reviews, content scheduling, tasks, and surveys and quizzes.
- Agency hub: add clients, see results per client, white-label monthly reports, edit message wording, pause or resume clients, raise tickets, and a sales kit.
- Built on HighLevel. Clients never see HighLevel or SellableCRM.

## How it works
1. Book a demo. Hub access with a demo client is given straight away.
2. Add a client with a 10-minute form in the hub.
3. A 30-minute setup call with our team.
4. Channels go live one by one. Texts start after SMS registration is approved.
About 40 minutes of the agency's time per client.

## Pricing (US dollars)
- $175 a month per live client. Billing begins when the client's first channel goes live.
- $300 one-time setup per client, charged when the client is confirmed.
- Usage (texts, calls and email) passed through from the second invoice, itemized per client, typically $15–30 a month.
- Custom work at $40 an hour, quoted in advance.
- No charge while a client is paused. Cancel any time from the hub.

## Common questions
- Will the agency's clients know SellableCRM exists? No. Texts, logins and reports carry the agency's brand, and SellableCRM never contacts the agency's clients.
- Who does the work? A dedicated team of specialists sets up, tests and maintains each client's account, registers texting with the carriers, checks lead sources and handles change requests.
- Does the agency need to learn HighLevel? No. The agency spends about 40 minutes per client: a 10-minute form and a 30-minute setup call.
- If the agency cancels a client, who keeps the data? The agency. It receives a full export of every lead and conversation for that client. Service stays active until the end of the current billing period, and cancellation can be reversed before then.

## Support
Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm Eastern. Tickets answered within 4 business hours.
